confirmed_findings.finding: 108 crossed-rectangle CAD placeholders were fabricated as computer worktables. Adjacent 3x3 placeholders become a continuous white raised slab with nine screens.
confirmed_findings.source_geometry: one rectangle + two diagonal LINE entities; no monitor, table, legs, conveyor evidence
confirmed_findings.action: Replace only these 108 instances with flush CAD cross-outline markers, preserve positions/rotations; exact operational use unconfirmed.

confirmed_findings.finding: 2E7F10 local CAD long axis X was mapped to GHS conveyor width X, while GHS travel axis is Y. Direct XY bbox scaling produces a wide short roller table with wrong roller/travel direction.
confirmed_findings.action: Dedicated geometry with actual 2E7CE9 belt boundary (2.42179 x .8m), source outer frame and X travel axis.

confirmed_findings.finding: All three source supply ramps use an unrelated generic GHS roller conveyor; the source supply-ramp drawing shows a belt and side-guides. 3D incline heights are not established by 2D CAD.
confirmed_findings.action: CAD footprint + continuous belt + display-only incline; preserve source XY and do not invent inter-machine links.

confirmed_findings.finding: The illustrated supply ramps are isolated in the original CAD too. There is no drawn connecting conveyor through the gap to the main line or compact machine head.
confirmed_findings.action: Keep source location; transport across gap needs manual handoff or documented equipment, not nearest-neighbour bridge.

confirmed_findings.finding: Named wheel sorters (20 M5A10 + 2 BAILUN) are represented by generic straight roller modules; the CAD name and detailed plan indicate transfer/sorting modules.
confirmed_findings.action: Mark as transfer device; route behavior remains unconfirmed, never treat as unidirectional straight through line automatically.

previously_corrected.quarter_turns: 9 arcs including mirrored *U33 retain CAD arcs; no repeat error found in generator

Supply ramps are offset and not connected in CAD. Individual 18 machine ports require component-level proof; do not use box centre as port.
topology_limits.2C9AE5: CAD assembly centre [-111.52478,16.36737]; current central roller x=-111.52,y=12.31737..20.41737 is hard-coded visual simplification. PW_TG_96C_IN contains infeed structure but its existing worktable placeholder is not a trustworthy endpoint. Four machine ports need component-level evidence.
topology_limits.2D41B7: Ground grid not a conveyor; isolated 2E7F10 infeed remains separated; do not join every short row to grid.
topology_limits.heights: All basic rollers use display height 1.0m, feed rows H1200/H1500 based plan labels use 1.2/1.5m assumptions, no source elevation guarantees. Generic GHS slopes must not define operational transfer height.
